learning.normalization: L = max_channels min((sum abs(h))^2, sum_i (N-i)*h[i]^2); alpha = gamma/L
learning.gainChoices: conservative gamma=0.35; default gamma=1.5; aggressive alpha=2.25/lambdaEstimate
learning.spectrumNote: L is a proven upper bound on ||P||_2^2. lambdaEstimate is a Rayleigh/power estimate, NOT a certified upper bound; it is used only for the deliberately aggressive setting.
learning.reset: Every trial resets every internal state; reference, disturbance, horizon and discretization remain fixed.
learning.limits: Educational linear models only. No input saturation, contact, torque command, sensor noise or hardware connection.
learning.sampleConvention: command[n] produces y[n]=C*x[n+1]; displayed time[n]=(n+1)*dt. Initial t=0 state is documented separately.

joint.title: 单关节闭环伺服
joint.modelNote: 一阶离散闭环等效伺服；反馈包含在对象中，学习量是参考角修正，不是力矩。固定的输出扰动每轮完全重复。

conservative.label: 保守步长
conservative.description: 以有限时域输入输出算子的谱范数上界缩放步长；固定重复模型下保证全时域误差二范数不增加。

default.label: 默认步长
default.description: 以有限时域输入输出算子的谱范数上界缩放步长；固定重复模型下保证全时域误差二范数不增加。

aggressive.label: 激进步长
aggressive.description: 步长按谱半径估计取到常用稳定区间之外；真实误差可能上升。超过阈值会停止，曲线不裁剪、不强制下降。

arm.modelNote: 两个独立的一阶闭环等效关节伺服，加2R正运动学；不包含耦合刚体动力学、重力、接触或真实力矩控制。
